name: fulfillment-service
title: Fulfillment service
summary: Platform storage and shipping for sellers: seller enrollment under service terms, SKU enrollment, inbound shipments to our warehouse, receiving into seller-owned stock, picking and shipping by us while the seller stays the seller of record, returns handling, removal of stock, and storage and handling fees with full seller visibility.
owns: Service enrollment: application, accepted service terms and fee schedule version, status, capacity allowance
SKU enrollment: which offers are fulfilled by Marketly, with dimensions, weight, labelling and restricted-item checks
Inbound shipments (seller → our warehouse): plan, boxes, carrier and tracking, arrival, receiving results, discrepancies and seller acknowledgement or claim
Ownership tracking: every unit in our warehouse that belongs to a seller is recorded against that seller (stock owner), never mixed with company stock
Fulfillment requests: orders for service offers routed to our warehouse; the seller remains the seller of record
Returns handling for service offers: receipt, inspection outcome on seller-owned stock (sellable, unsellable, removal)
Removal and disposal orders (sending stock back to the seller or disposing of it at the seller's request)
Fee schedule and fee charges: receiving, storage (per volume per month, long-term surcharge), pick and pack per unit and order, returns processing, removal; posted to finance as separate lines
Seller visibility: stock held by the company by group and fees charged
notOwns: Stock quantities and reservations: inventory (with owner = seller and location = our warehouse)
Physical receiving, picking, packing and labels: warehouse (works the tasks this module creates)
Shipments and tracking to customers: shipping
Return eligibility and refunds: returns and payments

publicApi.name: isServiceOffer
publicApi.desc: True when Marketly fulfils the offer, sellable or not: its SKU enrollment is active and the seller's enrollment is active, suspended or offboarding, and a service location exists (the same rule as getServiceTerms). Orders uses it to validate that a marketly_service group holds only service offers and a seller group none.

publicApi.name: getServiceTerms
publicApi.desc: Customer-facing fulfilment terms of Marketly-fulfilled offers, keyed by offer id; null when the offer is not Marketly-fulfilled (see isServiceOffer). Reads settings once per call; the profile comes from serviceShippingProfileId or shipping.getOfficialDefaultProfile, the location from serviceLocationId or inventory.getDefaultLocation, the parcel from the SKU's dimensions and weight. Offers resolves Offer.shipping for marketly_service offers with one batched call.

publicApi.name: getServiceLocation
publicApi.signature: () => { locationId: uuid, address: Address, shipsFrom: string } | null
publicApi.desc: The company warehouse that holds and ships seller stock (setting serviceLocationId, else inventory.getDefaultLocation); shipsFrom is its 'City, Region'. Null when no company location exists (then nothing is Marketly-fulfilled). Warehouse creates service fulfilments there and labels from its address; shipping quotes service packages from it.

publicApi.name: stockOwner
publicApi.desc: Owner of stock in our warehouse; reports and inventory use it to keep seller stock separate from company stock (plan ch. 9).

publicApi.name: createFulfillmentRequest
publicApi.signature: (orderId: uuid, sellerGroupId: uuid, items: { orderItemId: uuid, offerId: uuid, quantity: int }[]) => FulfillmentRequest
publicApi.desc: Kept for staff tooling and tests. Requests are created from orders.order.accepted (groups with fulfilledBy marketly_service); warehouse creates the pick work from the same event, so no module calls this.

publicApi.name: exportRows
publicApi.signature: (dataset: string, filters: json, principal: identity.Principal, cursor?: string) => { rows: json[], nextCursor?: string }
publicApi.desc: Rows of the datasets this module registers with reports.registerDataset at boot: fulfillment-service.seller.fees and fulfillment-service.seller.stock (seller audience, own rows only), fulfillment-service.admin.stock_by_owner (fulfillment-service.operations.view) and fulfillment-service.admin.fees (fulfillment-service.fees.manage).

stateMachines.name: Service enrollment
stateMachines.notes: activate happens when the first service receipt is confirmed by inventory (inventory.receipt.confirmed), not at the count. suspend stops new inbound shipments and new service-offer sales (offers become Ineligible with reason fulfillment_service_suspended, never seller-shipped; decision D5) but keeps fulfilling accepted orders and returns (plan ch. 10). offboarding also stops sales; it requires all stock to be removed or disposed before close; storage keeps accruing until then. Every suspend, reinstate, offboard and close publishes fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed for each active SKU.

stateMachines.name: SKU enrollment
stateMachines.notes: activate when a service receipt with sellable units is confirmed: inventory.setServiceLocation(stockItemId, service location) is applied first, then fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed (fulfilledBy marketly_service) is published and the offer shows 'Ships from Marketly'. deactivate when the seller stops using the service for the SKU (requires zero available units at the service location, else STOCK_REMAINING; reserved and other groups finish through orders, returns and removals): inventory.setServiceLocation(stockItemId, null), then service_changed with fulfilledBy seller, and the seller's own-location units sell again (decision D4).

stateMachines.name: Inbound shipment
stateMachines.notes: submit calls inventory.expectServiceInbound (Incoming at the service location); cancel calls inventory.cancelServiceInbound. Each receiving record (recordReceiving) is submitted as a service receipt (inventory.submitServiceReceipt); its units stay in the ledger's receiving group until the Inventory Manager confirms it (inventory confirmInbound → inventory.receipt.confirmed), then move to available (sellable) and unsellable (damaged) (decision D3). finishReceiving writes missing units and cancels the remaining Incoming. Discrepancies (short, damaged, extra) open a discrepancy the seller accepts or claims; close happens when it is resolved or after discrepancyResponseDays.

stateMachines.name: Removal order
stateMachines.notes: Disposal completes without shipping. Units are reserved out of available when approved (inventory.moveServiceStock available → damaged_held, reason service_removal_reserved) and leave stock on complete (damaged_held → out, service_removal_completed). Return-to-seller removals are worked by staff with tracking typed in (advanceRemoval); a warehouse removal-pick task and bought labels are a later step (decision D9).

stateMachines.name: Stock difference
stateMachines.notes: Opened by the reconcile job (one per SKU and day, with a fulfillment.reconciliation work item); resolved by staff with adjust_ledger (an adjusted ledger movement to match inventory), reimburse (a reimbursement accrued through the approval action fulfillment-service.reimbursements.approve; the difference stays open with approval set until access.approval.decided) or no_change. Decision D11: no automatic valuation.

stateMachines.name: Service fee charge
stateMachines.notes: Posted charges reach the seller statement as fulfillment-service lines separate from commission and ad charges. Reversal needs a reason; above the caller's limit it needs Finance approval.

consumes.name: orders.order.accepted
consumes.does: Create a fulfillment request for each group with fulfilledBy marketly_service (items = payload items filtered by the group's itemIds; ref and dispatchBy from the payload; no orders.getFulfillmentTask call) and reserve the units in the ownership ledger; notify the seller (seller.fulfillment.order_received). Declined payments never reach here, so no reservation leaks

consumes.name: orders.order.cancelled
consumes.does: Safety net: cancel any open request of the order and release its ledger reservations

consumes.name: orders.item.cancelled
consumes.does: Cancel or shorten open fulfillment requests and release seller-owned reservations

consumes.name: orders.item.split
consumes.does: Split the request item so later cancel, dispatch and return events naming newItemId match it (as warehouse and inventory do)

consumes.name: shipping.shipment.dispatched
consumes.does: For a request's group (fulfilledBy marketly_service): move that shipment's lines reserved → shipped in the ledger (claimed per shipmentId); the request is shipped when every uncancelled unit has shipped. Accrue pick-and-pack per shipment (key pick_pack:<requestId>:<shipmentId>:<tier>) and order handling once per request

consumes.name: warehouse.fulfillment.status_changed
consumes.does: Follow the warehouse task: request state picking, packed or short (with shortReportedAt and a fulfillment.requests work item); replaces reading warehouse progress on every list call

consumes.name: returns.return.received
consumes.does: For returned items of a shipped request (payload items: orderItemId, stockItemId, quantity): create a service return (return_ref, order_item_id), move the units into inventory returned at the service location (inventory.moveServiceStock out → returned, reason service_return_received) and the ledger, and accrue the returns processing fee

consumes.name: returns.return.inspected
consumes.does: Store returns' proposedStockOutcome on the service return as proposed_outcome; staff still record the outcome with recordReturnOutcome (decision D8)

consumes.name: inventory.receipt.confirmed
consumes.does: For source.kind service_inbound: per confirmed line move the ledger receiving → available (sellable) and receiving → unsellable (damaged), adding extra units from outside; mark the receipt confirmed; activate the SKU (first time: inventory.setServiceLocation, then fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed) and the enrollment if approved; notify the seller (seller.fulfillment.stock_available). Purchase-order receipts are ignored

consumes.name: inventory.adjustment.recorded
consumes.does: For serviceManaged movements (staff adjustments, counts and discrepancy resolutions at the service location): the ownership ledger follows with an adjusted movement carrying the inventory reason and movementId (claimed per movementId)

consumes.name: inventory.stock.low
consumes.does: For serviceManaged items: notify the seller to send more stock (seller.fulfillment.stock_low)

consumes.name: sellers.seller.suspended
consumes.does: Suspend the enrollment (remember the suspensionId) for new inbound and new service-offer sales; keep fulfilling accepted orders and returns

consumes.name: sellers.seller.reinstated
consumes.does: Reinstate an enrollment suspended by that suspension (endedSuspensionId = enrollments.seller_suspension_id); enrollments suspended by staff stay suspended

consumes.name: sellers.seller.closed
consumes.does: Start offboarding; ask the seller to remove stock

consumes.name: access.approval.decided
consumes.does: Apply approved fee schedules, reimbursements (discrepancies and stock differences) and fee reversals

TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED.meaning: The service terms and fee schedule must be accepted.

CAPACITY_EXCEEDED.meaning: The seller's storage or SKU allowance would be exceeded.

SKU_RESTRICTED.meaning: The item can't be stored (hazardous, oversize beyond limits, restricted category).

STOCK_REMAINING.meaning: Seller-owned stock is still in our warehouse; remove or dispose of it first.

INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.meaning: Not enough units in the requested stock group.

notes: Phase 4 (plan ch. 1, 12, 20): introduced only when warehouse responsibilities and service terms are ready; the module is off until the owner enables it (with serviceLocationId and serviceShippingProfileId set, or relying on the defaults). The prototype has no dedicated screens, so screen ids point at the existing inventory, receiving, pick-pack and finance screens that will host these views.

Owner decisions (all adopted). D1 outbound economics: customers see Marketly's rates (serviceShippingProfileId, else the Official Store default profile); the shipping charge stays in the seller's proceeds; the outbound label is billed to the seller (billedTo seller, already booked by finance); pick/pack and order handling follow the fee schedule. D2 service stock lives at the Official Store default warehouse (inventory.getDefaultLocation), or serviceLocationId for a later multi-warehouse rollout. D3 received units become sellable only after the Inventory Manager confirms the receipt in inventory's existing receipt confirmation queue. D4 while a SKU is active the item sells only from the Marketly location; the seller's own-location units are kept but not on sale and seller quantity edits are refused (inventory SERVICE_MANAGED); deactivating the SKU makes them sellable again. D5 a suspended or offboarding enrollment stops service offers selling (offers Ineligible, reason fulfillment_service_suspended), never switching them to seller shipping; accepted orders and returns continue. D6 cancellations and seller actions on service groups work like Official Store groups: instant until picking starts, then the Order Manager decides; the seller cannot prepare, delay, cancel, print slips, record shipments or answer cancellations (409 FULFILLED_BY_MARKETLY in orders and shipping). D7 returns of service items are platform handled from the request, auto-approved within the seller's return window, sent to returns.officialReturnAddress and inspected by Marketly; the refund is approved under policy and funded by the seller as seller of record; the seller sees them read-only. D8 recordReturnOutcome here is the single stock decision for a returned service unit; inventory stays out of seller returns. D9 removal orders are worked by staff through advanceRemoval with tracking typed in; a warehouse removal-pick task is a follow-up. D10 the seller sees only the city and region of a service order's address. D11 units lost or damaged in Marketly's custody are reimbursed by a staff decision per difference (resolveStockDifference, approval action fulfillment-service.reimbursements.approve); no automatic valuation. D12 the warehouseAddress setting is removed; the inbound destination is the service location's address (settings drops the stored key in a migration).

Flow end to end: the seller applies and is approved with capacity → enrolls an offer, staff approve the SKU → plans and submits an inbound (inventory.expectServiceInbound) → ships → staff record arrival and receiving (inventory.submitServiceReceipt; fulfillment-service.inbound.received; warehouse puts the units away) → the Inventory Manager confirms (inventory.receipt.confirmed) → ledger available, SKU and enrollment active, inventory.setServiceLocation, fulfillment-service.offer.service_changed → offers shows 'Ships from Marketly' with the service terms (getServiceTerms) → checkout makes a separate marketly_service package quoted with the service profile and Official closures → orders.order.accepted: warehouse creates the fulfilment at the service location (getServiceLocation) and this module the request → pick, pack, label billed to the seller, hand-over → shipping.shipment.dispatched: request shipped, pick/pack and order handling fees → returns come back platform handled to the Marketly dock → service return, staff record the outcome → fees post daily to finance as service_fee lines; reconcile compares the ledger with inventory daily.

Inventory calls (decision D3, D4): submit → expectServiceInbound({ inboundId, ref, locationId, lines }); cancel → cancelServiceInbound(inboundId); each receiving record → submitServiceReceipt({ receiptId = ServiceReceipt.id, … }) plus an inbound_receipts row; found units → moveServiceStock out → available (service_found); removal approve → available → damaged_held (service_removal_reserved); removal complete → damaged_held → out (service_removal_completed); return received → out → returned (service_return_received); return outcome → returned → available (service_return_restocked), damaged_held (service_return_unsellable) or out (service_return_disposed); staff reconcile corrections → service_reconcile. Idempotency keys fs:<what>:<id>[:<skuEnrollmentId>] (e.g. fs:return-received:<serviceReturnId>). The old read-then-set of seller quantities through applyBulkQuantities on the seller's own location is gone.
Ledger movement values are unchanged (received, released, shipped, returned, restocked, adjusted, …); inventory movements carry the reason codes above as is.

Notifications: this module calls notifications.notify for every topic below (notifications declares the topics and templates; seller preference group fulfillment_service, permission fulfillment-service.inbound.manage): seller.fulfillment.enrollment_decided (dedupe fs:enrollment:<id>:<state>; enrollment.state, reason), seller.fulfillment.sku_reviewed (fs:sku:<id>:review; sku, approved, reason), seller.fulfillment.inbound_received (fs:inbound:<id>:received; inbound.ref, received, damaged, discrepancy), seller.fulfillment.stock_available (fs:receipt:<receiptId>:confirmed; inbound.ref, units), seller.fulfillment.discrepancy_decided (fs:discrepancy:<inboundId>; inbound.ref, decision), seller.fulfillment.order_received (fs:order:<groupId>; order.ref, items), seller.fulfillment.return_inspected (fs:return:<serviceReturnId>; return.ref, outcome), seller.fulfillment.removal_completed (fs:removal:<id>; removal.ref, units), seller.fulfillment.stock_low (fs:low:<skuEnrollmentId>:<day>; stock.label, available), seller.fulfillment.stock_aged (fs:aged:<sellerId>:<week>; units, effective), seller.fulfillment.disposal_scheduled (fs:dispose:<removalId>; units, days, removal.ref), seller.fulfillment.fee_schedule_changed (fs:schedule:<id>; version, effective), seller.fulfillment.offboarding (fs:offboarding:<enrollmentId>; removal.refs); staff.fulfillment.enrollment_submitted (role seller_manager; fs:enrollment:<id>:submitted), staff.fulfillment.inbound_submitted (role warehouse_manager; fs:inbound:<id>:submitted), staff.fulfillment.discrepancy_claimed (role warehouse_manager; fs:inbound:<id>:claimed). Low stock no longer reuses seller.stock.low, and aged stock, disposal and fee schedules no longer reuse seller.platform.change_scheduled.

Work items (workqueues.raise, resolved with resolveBySource; queues seeded by workqueues): fulfillment.receiving (warehouse_manager, ops/receiving, kind receiving; dedupe fs_inbound_overdue:<inboundId> and fs_discrepancy:<inboundId>), fulfillment.reconciliation (inventory_manager, ops/inventory, kind manual_task; fs_stock_difference:<skuEnrollmentId>), fulfillment.requests (warehouse_manager, ops/pick-pack, kind pick_pack; fs_request_short:<requestId>), fulfillment.enrollments (seller_manager, admin/sellers, kind application_waiting; fs_enrollment:<id> and fs_sku:<id>, resolved on decision).
Audit: every audited endpoint writes an audit entry through the optional audit module (ctx.tryUse('audit')).

Exports (reports.registerDataset at boot when reports is on; rows from exportRows): fulfillment-service.seller.fees, fulfillment-service.seller.stock, fulfillment-service.admin.stock_by_owner, fulfillment-service.admin.fees.

Finance credits: postAll reads a pending reimbursement with finance.getSellerCredit({ idempotencyKey }) instead of calling creditSeller again; reversing an accrued reimbursement whose credit is pending calls finance.withdrawSellerCredit.
Selling and shipping are separate: the seller stays the named seller of record on the offer, order and invoice; offers only add 'Ships from Marketly'.

Ownership: inventory holds the quantities with owner = seller at the service location (stock_items.service_location_id); this module keeps the ownership ledger and reconciles daily. Seller stock is never pooled with company stock and reports identify the stock owner and the charges (plan ch. 9).
Fees are seller charges separate from commission and ad charges; finance shows them as their own statement lines. Fee schedules are versioned with effective dates and seller notice.
Physical work (receiving, pick, pack, returns inspection) is done by warehouse tasks; this module creates and tracks them and records outcomes that concern ownership and fees.
